subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Does the incremental due-job finalization approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 cover this latest-release scheduled isolated `agentTurn` report, or is a narrower single-job SQLite reproduction needed first?
rationale: Source inspection proves the stale-marker skip mechanism and an overlapping due-batch buffering path, but it does not fully prove the reporter's exact single-job recurrence failure on current main.

options.title: Rebase and adapt the candidate PR
options.body: Carry the per-result finalization behavior through current main and add an exact scheduled isolated `agentTurn` SQLite regression for this report.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Hold the fix path until a maintainer or contributor reproduces the latest-release single-job failure in a live gateway setup.

options.title: Split a narrower fix
options.body: If the candidate PR is too broad after rebase, open a smaller current-base fix only for the `running_at_ms` persistence path.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adapt the candidate PR
recommendation.body: Carry the per-result finalization behavior through current main and add an exact scheduled isolated `agentTurn` SQLite regression for this report.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron task/state reconciliation plus maintainer-routing context makes this the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
